name: Crazy Eights
about: Match the suit or the rank. An 8 changes the suit. Be first out of cards.
how: Play a card of the same suit or rank as the top card of the pile.
An 8 goes on any card. Then you pick the next suit.
No card to play? Draw one. The first player with no cards wins.

name: Go Fish
about: Ask for a rank you hold. Collect books of four. Most books wins.
how: Tap a card in your hand, then the player to ask for that rank.
They give you all of that rank, and you ask again. None? Go fishing: take a card from the pond.
Four of a rank make a book. The most books wins.

name: Memory
about: Turn two cards. Find a pair and play again. Most pairs wins.
how: Turn two cards.
A pair? You keep it and play again. No pair? Remember where they are.
When the table is empty, the most pairs wins.

name: Ludo
about: Roll a 6 to come out. Race your four tokens home and send others back.
how: Roll the die. A 6 brings a token out and gives you another roll.
Tap a token to move it. Land on another player's token to send it back to base. Stars are safe.
Bring all four tokens to the middle, with an exact roll, to win.

name: Four in a Row
about: Drop discs in turn. Make a line of four across, up or on a slant.
how: Tap a column to drop your disc into it.
Take turns with the other player.
Make a line of four, across, up or on a slant, to win.

name: Quiz Race
about: Answer sums and kids' facts. Each right answer is a step. First home wins.
how: Read the question and tap the answer.
A right answer moves you one step along the track.
The first player to reach step 10 wins.

name: Sudoku
about: Fill the grid so each row, column and box has 1 to 9 once. Four levels.
how: Tap a square, then a number. Each row, column and 3×3 box holds 1 to 9 once.
Notes puts small pencil marks. A placed number clears it from the notes around it.
Red means a repeat. Stuck? Hint shows one right step, and Undo takes a move back.

name: Crossword
about: Today's puzzle, or pick a topic. Read the clue and fill in the word.
how: Tap a square. Tap it again to go across or down. The clue shows above the grid.
Type the letters. A finished word turns green.
Stuck? Hint gives one right letter.
